name: FLIP-16
description: GPU-16 with a double buffered screen. The rasterizer draws each frame in the back buffer, out of sight, and one SWAP shows it whole: the same cube as GPU-16, without seeing every frame cleared and redrawn. A real time clock can show the frames on a steady beat, and the cube also comes as a coloured wireframe.

programs.name: A triangle drawn out of sight
programs.description: The rasterizer fills it in the back buffer; SWAP shows it in one tick

programs.description: GPU-16's cube with a SWAP after each frame

programs.name: A steady spinning cube
programs.description: The cube shown on the beat of FRAME CLOCK, a real time clock: ten frames a second, however long each takes to draw
